name: 19801 · Wilmington, DE
findings: ZIP 19801 (Wilmington) has 459 nonprofit organizations. 158 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 134 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19801 (Wilmington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19801 (Wilmington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 9.5 times the typical level).
